description: Ruth Kelleher has received a call from Marian Prowse about the deposit deadline. Ruth is aware that the deposit must be in Marian's account by end of Wednesday 16th September. Ruth has not yet paid the deposit herself and is waiting to see how the group will handle it.
Dev Sandhu has expressed enthusiasm for the trip twice in the thread but has not yet paid any deposit. He is aware of the deadline.
Nina Achebe has not replied to the thread about the trip. She is aware of the deposit requirement but has not communicated her decision.
Marian Prowse is holding the week for the group until end of Wednesday 16th September. She has not yet received any deposit.
Ruth sends a WhatsApp message to the group chat with Dev and Nina: 'Marian called - the deposit of £600 (£200 each) must be in her account by end of Wednesday 16th. How do we want to handle it?'
Nina sends the reply message to the trip thread, visible to Ruth, Dev, and Marian.
Dev picks up his phone and sees Ruth's WhatsApp message in the group chat.

Dev sends a reply in the group chat: 'I'm still keen but I've had a big expense with the clutch. I can't do the full £200 by Wednesday unless I use my credit card, which I promised my wife I'd stop. Can we split it differently or is there flexibility?'
The message from Dev arrives on Ruth's phone as a notification in the group chat.
Ruth notices the notifications on her phone and opens the group chat, seeing Nina's reply and Dev's message.

Ruth sends a message in the group chat: 'Thanks both for the replies. I'm glad we're all still keen. I can pay a larger share of the deposit upfront if you can pay me back later, but I can't cover the whole £600 myself. Maybe we can do £300 from me and £150 each from you? Let me know what works.'
Ruth's reply message is sent to the group chat, visible to Dev, Nina, and Marian.
Ruth's message arrives on Dev's phone as a notification in the group chat.
Dev's phone receives the notification of Ruth's message at 20:40, but at 21:25 Dev is not looking at his phone, so the messages remain unread.
Nina's phone receives the notifications for the group chat messages, but she is occupied with her mother and does not check her phone.
Marian checks her phone and sees the group chat messages from Ruth, Dev, and Nina.
Dev checks his phone and sees the notifications for the group chat messages from Nina and Ruth. He opens the chat and reads Nina's reply and Ruth's proposal about splitting the deposit.

Dev sends the message in the group chat: 'Thanks Ruth, that's really generous. I can do £100 by Wednesday but I'd need to borrow the other £50 from someone until payday on the 28th, or if there's any flexibility on timing? Otherwise I might have to use my credit card as a last resort.'
Dev's message arrives on Ruth's phone as a notification in the group chat.
Ruth's phone displays a notification from the group chat with Dev's message, but she is busy and does not see it yet.

Ruth sends the message in the group chat: 'Morning! Just checking if you both saw my suggestion last night. I can do £300 now if you each do £150. Let me know if that works or if you have another idea – we need to sort it by Wednesday.'
Ruth's phone displays notifications from the group chat, but she remains busy and does not check them.
Nina opens the group chat and sees the messages from Ruth and Dev, including Ruth's deposit proposal and Dev's response, as well as her own earlier reply.
Dev's phone receives the notification of Ruth's morning message, but he does not see it yet.
Ruth picks up her phone and sees the notifications from the group chat, including Dev's message from 08:10 and her own morning message. She opens the chat and reads Dev's response.

Ruth sends the message in the group chat: 'Thanks Dev, I understand. My offer still stands – I can front £300 now, you do £150 (or £100 now and the rest later), and Nina does £150. That way no one uses credit cards. Nina, what do you think? We need to decide today so I can transfer the deposit.'
Dev's phone receives the notification of Ruth's message in the group chat.
Dev's phone receives the notification of Ruth's message from 11:01, but Dev is not looking at his phone, so the messages remain unread.
Dev's phone remains in his pocket or nearby, with unread notifications from the group chat. He does not check his phone at this moment.
Ruth sends a private WhatsApp message to Nina: 'Nina, I haven't heard back from you. Can you do £150 by Wednesday? I can front the other £150 if needed, but need to know today.'
Nina's phone receives the private WhatsApp message from Ruth, displaying a notification on the lock screen.
Ruth sends a WhatsApp message to Dev individually: 'Dev, can you confirm if you can do £100 by Wednesday and I cover the extra £50? Need to know so I can sort the deposit.'
Dev's phone receives the notification of Ruth's private message, but he does not see it.

Ruth sends a WhatsApp message to Dev individually: 'Dev, it's 1pm and I need to know by 5pm today if you can do £100 now and I cover the extra £50, or if you can do the full £150. Otherwise I'm going to have to tell Marian we can't do it.'

Ruth sends a WhatsApp message to Nina: 'Nina, I need a yes or no by 5pm today on whether you can do £150 by Wednesday. I can front the other £150 but need to know. If I don't hear from you, I'll assume you're out and I'll have to cancel the booking.'
Dev's phone receives the notification of Ruth's private message from 13:01, but he does not see it.
Dev's phone continues to display unread notifications from the group chat and from Ruth, but Dev does not check his phone at this moment.
Ruth sends a message to the group chat: 'It's 5pm and I haven't heard back from either of you. I'm going to have to tell Marian we can't take the cottage this week. Sorry everyone.'
Ruth calls Marian Prowse.
Dev's phone receives the notification of Ruth's message in the group chat, but Dev does not see it.
Nina's phone continues to display unread notifications from the group chat and Ruth's private messages, but Nina does not check her phone.
Ruth tells her children that the cottage trip is cancelled.
Dev picks up his phone and sees the lock screen with multiple unread notifications from the group chat and from Ruth.
Marian's phone receives a notification of Ruth's call at 17:00, but Marian does not answer. The call goes to voicemail. The group chat messages remain unread on her phone.
Marian checks her bank account online and sees no deposit of £600 or any partial payments from the group.
Marian opens the group chat and sees all the messages from Ruth, Dev, and Nina, including Ruth's final message that she's cancelling.
Marian calls Ruth's phone number.
Marian calls Ruth again. The call goes to voicemail.
Marian calls the Leeds couple to offer the October half-term week at Cove Cottage.
